rapport_notes: Warm, reassuring tone; genuine empathy shown ("I know moving is stressful"); customer explicitly praised her directness and felt relieved.
process_discipline_notes: On-Time Guarantee and Meet Your Mover both mentioned in Stage 1 (as differentiators) and then repeated in Stage 2/3; no silence held after 'does that make sense?' questions.

evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: We'll just start with a few questions to get us on the right track and then we'll be able to build you an accurate quote.
evidence_quotes.agenda: You have any questions or concerns specifically you would like answered on this call.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer said 'I'm just trying to line up a bunch of quotes and pick the cheapest one' — rep replied 'Yeah, of course' and immediately pivoted to packing logistics rather than probing deeper on price sensitivity, concerns, or timeline. No second-layer follow-up.
evidence_quotes.sheet1_careful_with: We do have a no worries damage coverage which is our free evaluation coverage included in our hourly rate that provides up to $2,000 per move to repair, replace or reimburse for accidental damages.
evidence_quotes.sheet2_whos_coming: We few days free move you'll receive a meet your mover email introducing them to you helping you ease attention of strangers arriving at your front door.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_stage1: We do have our on time guarantee we value your time. So, if we can't make it in the time window that we arrange, we immediately start discounting money of your final bill.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_stage3_repeat: Taking note of those especially with those 275 inch t.v.s when you're shopping around, make sure that they have insurance above that 60¢ per pound...
evidence_quotes.communication_stage1: [Meet Your Mover email mentioned in Stage 1]
evidence_quotes.communication_stage3_repeat: The day before the move we would give you a call and make sure to confirm and then the day of we would also give you a call when we're on our way.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Typical move the size takes two movers one truck between two and a half to three and a half hours. So I definitely feel like you would fall within that range.
evidence_quotes.beats_it_pay_less: Once you go over the two and a half hours, we only charge in fifteen minute increments, so we don't charge for a half hour.
evidence_quotes.estimate_is_a_window: Once you go over the two and a half hours, we only charge in fifteen minute increments... you only pay for the time that we are there moving you.
evidence_quotes.close_rate_lock: [Implied in payment discussion but not explicitly stated as 'your rate locks when you book']
evidence_quotes.close_ask: I can get you on the schedule... or I can go ahead and send you an email with all the information. [Customer decides to shop around and get email; no explicit closing ask for immediate booking.]

top_strength: Exceptional rapport and warmth—customer explicitly said 'You've been straightforward. I love it' and felt relieved, and Brianne's proactive damage-coverage comparison directly addressed a real customer pain point (shopping by price alone).
coaching_note: Stage 1: when the customer signals price-shopping as the agenda, dig one layer deeper (timeline pressure? budget cap? what else matters besides price?) rather than pivoting immediately to logistics—you left money on the table by not uncovering the full buying criteria. Also: avoid repeating differentiators already covered in Stage 1; deliver them once, in the right slot.
